Questly at the very end. Avoid further full gates between EO pieces.

No separate FULL per piece. TermAl does the same for w-8f4c, w-37d9 and w-7ebf. Then one restart. Live Questly and Phoenix proofs come LAST.
RULE: don't run heavy gates on partial EO pieces; finish the feature's coding with author focused tests, integrate once, validate once.
